description: leads has no UPDATE/DELETE policy and no status columns, so agents cannot mark leads handled or delete them.
triage_reason: defer: lead triage and deletion belong to a later leads-management story.

description: Policy "agents read leads…" lets every agent read all listing_id-null leads, and on delete set null turns a deleted listing's leads into such leads.
triage_reason: decision-needed: whether general or orphaned leads should be agent-owned is a product choice.

description: Anonymous lead insert has no rate limit, no length limits and only a weak email check.
triage_reason: defer: abuse limits are better added at the API layer in S03/S04.

description: Anon insert on leads with returning/Prefer: return=representation fails because anon has no SELECT policy on leads.
triage_reason: reject: plain insert works and no returning is a normal PostgREST pattern.

description: listing_images.position is not unique per listing, so gallery order can be ambiguous.
triage_reason: defer: a unique (listing_id, position) index needs the reorder strategy decided first.

description: open_house_at has no check against published or future state.
triage_reason: reject: no spec requirement.

description: Slug is globally unique but has no change/redirect rule, so changing it breaks URLs.
triage_reason: reject: slug handling is an application concern.

description: neighborhood is free text with no enum or lookup, so spelling variants will break filters.
triage_reason: reject: a lookup table is out of scope for S01.

description: agents.email duplicates auth.users.email with no uniqueness or sync.
triage_reason: reject: the copy is intentional so the profile can be public.

description: agents.id cascades on auth user delete but listings.agent_id is restrict, so deleting an auth user fails opaquely.
triage_reason: defer: handle agent offboarding when auth management is built.

description: Agents can freely set published_at and featured on their own listings.
triage_reason: reject: this is intended, since agents manage their own listings.

description: Agents can edit created_at.
triage_reason: reject: negligible.

description: set_updated_at has no pinned search_path, and agents has no updated_at.
triage_reason: patch: add `set search_path = ''` to the function. It is a trivial, unambiguous fix.

description: No explicit grant/revoke statements, so access relies on Supabase default grants.
triage_reason: reject: Supabase default grants plus RLS are the standard pattern.

description: published_at <= now() cannot use the partial index on published_at is not null.
triage_reason: reject: false, because Postgres can use a partial index for `published_at <= now()`, which implies `is not null`.

description: No full-text or trigram index for searching title, description or neighborhood.
triage_reason: reject: search is out of scope.

description: No index on leads.created_at or on price sort, and listings_filter_idx omits neighborhood, bedrooms and featured.
triage_reason: reject: speculative indexing.

description: Seed hardcodes password123 with no guard against running on a remote or staging database.
triage_reason: defer: the comment says local only, so add a guard when a deploy pipeline exists.

description: Seed uses relative now() times, so data is non-deterministic across resets.
triage_reason: reject: relative dates are intentional.

description: Seed images use picsum.photos URLs that will not match the future storage bucket.
triage_reason: reject: placeholders are fine.

description: Spec's "36 images" claim does not match the 3-images-per-listing seed.
triage_reason: reject: false, 12 published × 3 = 36 is consistent.

description: No automated RLS tests (pgTAP or SQL), so the RLS claims are not reproducible in CI.
triage_reason: defer: add a Supabase-backed test harness with the S03/S04 API stories.

description: No down/rollback migration and no regenerated TypeScript DB types for downstream stories.
triage_reason: reject: out of scope.

description: Sprint status says review while the spec says done.
triage_reason: reject: the fix would edit the spec or sprint file.

description: Spec says review subagents were not launched, yet the story moved to review.
triage_reason: reject: process note, and the fix edits the spec.

description: Spec filename differs from the sprint-status key.
triage_reason: reject: naming only.

description: agents has no DELETE policy.
triage_reason: reject: low impact, since the agents row cascades from auth.

description: Seed inserts into auth.users and auth.identities with internal columns that may break on Supabase CLI upgrades.
triage_reason: reject: `db reset` was verified per the spec notes.

description: Spec has empty context and route 'oneshot', leaving no recorded acceptance criteria.
triage_reason: reject: the fix edits the spec.

description: Deleting a listing sets leads.listing_id to null, making those leads readable by every agent.
triage_reason: decision-needed: same root as 2.

description: General (listing_id null) leads have no owner, so any agent can read all of them.
triage_reason: decision-needed: same root as 2.

description: Anon lead insert has no limits on name, message or phone length.
triage_reason: defer: same as 3.

description: Anon insert with returning fails with an RLS violation.
triage_reason: reject: same as 4.

description: Two images for one listing can share the same position.
triage_reason: defer: same as 5.

description: listing_images.url accepts any text, including empty strings or non-http schemes.
triage_reason: reject: an img src is not executable and the values are agent-controlled.

description: Only one of latitude/longitude can be supplied.
triage_reason: reject: low impact and not required.

description: open_house_at can be set on drafts or unpublished listings.
triage_reason: reject: same as 6.

description: set_updated_at has a mutable search_path.
triage_reason: patch: same as 13.

description: No unpublish state, so sold/withdrawn listings stay visible while published_at is in the past.
triage_reason: reject: nulling published_at is the unpublish mechanism, and a status column is outside the spec.

description: Any authenticated user can insert their own agents row and so become an agent who can publish listings and read general leads.
triage_reason: decision-needed: whether agent self-signup should be allowed is a policy choice.

description: agents is fully public to anon, including email and phone.
triage_reason: reject: the spec says agents are public profiles shown on listing detail.

description: Deleting an auth user who owns listings fails because of on delete restrict.
triage_reason: defer: same as 10.

description: Seed could fail on re-run or if crypt/gen_salt is not on the search_path.
triage_reason: reject: seed runs after the migration on `db reset`, and it was verified.

description: Images are seeded for draft and scheduled listings, so the anon "36 images" count depends on RLS.
triage_reason: reject: hiding those images is exactly what RLS is meant to do.

description: Claim "anyone may insert leads" is narrower in the policy, which rejects leads on unpublished listings.
triage_reason: reject: the hardening is sensible and the spec's "anyone" is satisfied for valid targets.

description: Cross-agent isolation (agent B vs agent A's rows) is not recorded as verified.
triage_reason: defer: covered by the automated RLS test item (22).

description: RLS policies and seed counts have no automated test, and the only test in the repo is expect(true).toBe(true).
triage_reason: defer: same as 22.

description: Anon insert on leads with returning fails because anon has no SELECT policy on leads.
triage_reason: reject: same as 4.

description: Seed ships a known password for an auth user, with no check that seed runs only locally.
triage_reason: defer: same as 18.

description: Story marked review with no triage recorded in the spec.
triage_reason: reject: process, and the fix edits the spec or sprint file.

description: Spec status done conflicts with sprint status review.
triage_reason: reject: same as 24.

description: Leads insert policy is narrower than the literal "anyone may insert leads".
triage_reason: reject: same as 45.

description: Agents can read all null-listing leads, and leads of deleted listings, which does not match "agents manage their own rows".
triage_reason: decision-needed: same root as 2.

description: Agents cannot delete their own profile row.
triage_reason: reject: same as 27.

description: Seed depends on the Supabase auth schema version, and the db reset verification cannot be confirmed from the diff.
triage_reason: reject: same as 28.

description: Images use external picsum.photos URLs, so "original" content is not strictly met for images.
triage_reason: reject: same as 20.

description: Public select policy on storage.objects lets anon list every object in the bucket, including photos of draft or unpublished listings.
triage_reason: patch | Real but low impact, and the spec intends a public bucket. Patch only if the product wants a draft-photo restriction. I treat it as defer, see item 46.

description: RLS on the `listing_images` table is not covered here, and no test shows non-owners cannot insert, reorder or delete rows.
triage_reason: defer | The `listing_images` table RLS was set in S01 and is outside this diff.

description: Upload, reorder and delete are not atomic and race, for example two concurrent uploads get the same position and a failed reorder leaves a half-applied order.
triage_reason: defer | Atomicity needs an RPC or transaction, a larger design change. Not patched in this story.

description: The storage `remove()` result is ignored in both the upload rollback and the delete path.
triage_reason: patch | Check the `remove` errors, at least in the delete path, with a direct fix.

description: The reorder update has no `.eq("listing_id")` guard, and zero-row update or delete is reported as success.
triage_reason: patch | Scope the update with `.eq("listing_id")` and use `.select()` to detect zero rows. Low severity.

description: `deleteListingImage` trusts the caller-supplied image object (url, listing_id) instead of fetching the row.
triage_reason: reject | Callers hold DB-fetched rows, and RLS limits what a bad object can do.

description: `pathFromPublicUrl` does not check host or origin, and `decodeURIComponent` can throw on malformed input.
triage_reason: patch | Wrap `decodeURIComponent` in try/catch. This is a real throw after the row is deleted.

description: `validateImageFile` trusts the client-supplied `file.type` and does no magic-byte check.
triage_reason: reject | The bucket's `allowed_mime_types` enforces this server-side.

description: `alt_text` has no length or content validation and there is no cap on images per listing.
triage_reason: reject | Speculative hardening with no demonstrated harm.

description: `listingId` is never validated as a UUID.
triage_reason: reject | The foreign key and RLS already reject invalid IDs.

description: The 10 MB limit is hard-coded separately in SQL and TS, so the two can drift.
triage_reason: reject | Cosmetic drift risk only.

description: The persisting functions (upload, reorder, delete) have no tests, not even with a mocked client.
triage_reason: patch | Add stubbed-client tests for upload, reorder and delete. This is the strongest test gap.

description: No committed SQL or pgTAP tests for the RLS policies, so the manual 200/403/415 checks are not reproducible.
triage_reason: defer | Needs a Supabase integration harness the repo doesn't have yet.

description: Missing unit cases: orderImages tie-break, negative moveImage index, encoded pathFromPublicUrl, unsupported MIME in buildImagePath.
triage_reason: reject | Low-value extra cases.

description: The `create policy` statements are not idempotent, unlike the bucket upsert.
triage_reason: reject | Migrations run once, and the bucket upsert is already idempotent.

description: The same owner `exists` subquery is repeated across three write policies.
triage_reason: reject | Duplication is acceptable at this size.

description: No supporting index on `listings(agent_id)` for the per-row policy subquery.
triage_reason: reject | `listings.id` is the primary key, and no performance harm was shown.

description: `(storage.foldername(name))[1]` does not guard against nested or odd paths.
triage_reason: reject | Duplicates item 19 below and has no demonstrated exploit.

description: The behavior of the update policy when renaming an object into another owned listing's folder is untested.
triage_reason: reject | The `with check` clause covers it, and no harm was shown.

description: The header comment says `{listing_id}/{filename}` but the TS uses `{uuid}.{ext}`.
triage_reason: reject | Comment drift only.

description: The spec says `done` while sprint-status says `review`.
triage_reason: reject | A process artifact, and fixing it means editing the spec.

description: The spec records no code review or triage before marking the story complete.
triage_reason: reject | Process observation, and fixing it means editing the spec.

description: The story key in sprint-status is truncated and does not match the spec filename.
triage_reason: reject | Out of scope, and fixing it means editing the spec.

description: The spec Intent names no acceptance criteria and no non-goals.
triage_reason: reject | Fix is to edit the spec under review.

description: Deleting a listing cascades `listing_images` rows but leaves its storage objects.
triage_reason: defer | Storage cleanup on listing deletion is a real gap but belongs to a later story.

description: A reorder update affecting zero rows (RLS or vanished id) returns no error, so success is reported falsely.
triage_reason: patch | Same root cause as item 5, zero-row reorder succeeds silently.

description: An update failing midway through the sequential loop leaves the gallery partially reordered.
triage_reason: defer | Duplicate of item 3, needs a transaction or RPC.

description: A delete matching zero rows returns no error, then storage removal still runs.
triage_reason: patch | Same root cause as item 5, zero-row delete.

description: The unchecked storage remove error in delete leaves orphaned files.
triage_reason: patch | Duplicate of item 4.

description: The compensating remove after a failed insert ignores its own error.
triage_reason: patch | Duplicate of item 4, the upload rollback.

description: If gap-closing throws after a successful delete, the caller sees an error although the image is gone.
triage_reason: defer | Needs the transactional redesign in item 3.

description: Two concurrent uploads read the same positions and produce duplicates.
triage_reason: defer | Duplicate of item 3, concurrent uploads.

description: Reorder uses a stale snapshot, so concurrent upload or reorder can collide positions.
triage_reason: defer | Duplicate of item 3, stale snapshot.

description: Malformed percent-encoding throws URIError after the row is already deleted, and a query string or fragment in the URL is not stripped.
triage_reason: patch | Duplicate of item 7.

description: A NaN or non-integer `file.size` passes the size checks.
triage_reason: reject | The bucket enforces the limit server-side.

description: MIME case or parameters (`IMAGE/JPEG`, `; charset`) are rejected and fail the EXTENSIONS lookup.
triage_reason: reject | A strict MIME check is acceptable behavior.

description: An empty or `/`-containing listingId yields a malformed or nested path.
triage_reason: reject | Duplicate of item 10.

description: A NaN or fractional `toIndex` silently moves the image to index 0.
triage_reason: reject | Callers are UI-driven, so this is unlikely to be hit.

description: `created_at` is compared as a string, so mixed formats or offsets sort differently from the DB.
triage_reason: reject | Negligible, and Postgres timestamps are uniform.

description: `Math.max(...spread)` can throw on huge arrays and yields NaN with a null position.
triage_reason: reject | Negligible for realistic gallery sizes.

description: Non-idempotent policy creation fails on re-run.
triage_reason: reject | Duplicate of item 15.

description: Listing deletion or agent_id change leaves orphaned objects that no agent can delete.
triage_reason: defer | Duplicate of item 25.

description: The select policy exposes all bucket objects, including those of draft listings.
triage_reason: reject | Duplicate of item 1, no harm was shown.

description: The policy allows nested subfolder paths like `{id}/x/y.png`.
triage_reason: reject | Duplicate of item 18.

description: The spec's API checks used raw REST calls, so the persisting functions were never executed.
triage_reason: defer | Duplicate of item 13.

description: Storage RLS and bucket config have no repeatable test, so a cross-tenant hole would ship with green tests.
triage_reason: defer | Duplicate of item 13. (Item 1: public read of draft photos is deferred, not patched.)

description: Position and ordering logic in upload, reorder and delete is untested, even with a stub client.
triage_reason: patch | Duplicate of item 12.

description: Reorder is non-transactional and upload's position computation is read-then-insert (an "other" finding).
triage_reason: defer | Duplicate of item 3.

description: The delete path ignores the storage `remove` error (an "other" finding).
triage_reason: patch | Duplicate of item 4.

description: `decodeURIComponent` throws URIError instead of ListingImageError after the row is deleted (an "other" finding).
triage_reason: patch | Duplicate of item 7.

description: The migration comment `{filename}` conflicts with the spec's `{uuid}.{ext}` convention, a documentation drift only.
triage_reason: reject | Documentation drift only.

description: Delete removes the DB row before the storage object with no rollback, and the remove error is ignored.
triage_reason: patch | Duplicate of item 4.

description: Gap-closing in delete relies on the row-by-row reorder, so partial failure leaves positions not dense.
triage_reason: defer | Duplicate of item 3.

description: Concurrent uploads can get the same position because the index is not unique.
triage_reason: defer | Duplicate of item 3.

description: The persisting functions are untested, and the spec says `done` while sprint-status says `review`.
triage_reason: reject | Duplicate of items 21 and 22, and fixing it means editing the spec.

description: The 403/415/200 verification claims cannot be reproduced from the diff.
triage_reason: defer | Duplicate of item 13.

description: `select("*, images:listing_images(*)")` returns every column, so future internal fields could leak, and `data` has no real type.
triage_reason: defer — all columns are public today (the S03 triage log reached the same conclusion). Revisit when internal fields are added.

description: The past-the-end fallback runs a second count query. Nothing tests that it applies the same filters, and `new Date()` is evaluated twice, so `total` can disagree with the page.
triage_reason: patch — add assertions that the fallback head query reuses the same filters. This is the same gap as raised finding 17.

description: `ilike` "exact match" for neighborhood is still affected by accents and whitespace, and the matching rule isn't pinned in the contract.
triage_reason: reject — case-insensitive matching meets the spec. Accent and whitespace handling is a product decision, not a defect.

description: The integer parser rejects decimals such as `1000.50`, and repeated params silently use the first value.
triage_reason: reject — integer-only is intentional for the spec'd fields. Repeated params are covered by 15.

description: The `min_price > max_price` error is attached to `min_price` only, and bedrooms/bathrooms have no upper bound.
triage_reason: patch — also flag `max_price` in the cross-field error. This is a trivial change and also resolves 22.

description: A missing env var throws inside the handler and surfaces as a generic 500 "Failed to load listings". `createPublicClient` has no test.
triage_reason: defer — a config error returning a generic 500 is acceptable. A test for `createPublicClient` is covered by 19.

description: `force-dynamic`, no `Cache-Control` header and no rate limiting on a public `count: "exact"` endpoint, with no follow-up story recorded.
triage_reason: defer — caching and rate limiting are hardening work. Record a follow-up story.

description: Tests use a permissive fake client and no integration test hits real PostgREST. The `ilike` escape is untested for backslash, `total_pages` is untested for total 0, and null/empty images are untested.
triage_reason: defer — the integration test needs infrastructure. Cheap unit gaps are covered by 17, 18 and 20.

description: The spec says `status: done` while `sprint-status.yaml` says `review`.
triage_reason: reject — this is a process artifact, not code (see 27).

description: The spec has no acceptance criteria, and the 400/500 response shapes aren't documented as an API contract. It also lists "map" as a consumer but defines no coordinate filter.
triage_reason: reject — the spec has no acceptance criteria and no coordinate filter, and the API contract is out of scope for the code. The spec is frozen.

description: `bedrooms`/`bathrooms` above 32767 pass validation and cause a Postgres smallint out-of-range error, which returns 500 instead of 400.
triage_reason: patch — add a max cap (32767) for bedrooms/bathrooms, so oversized values return 400 instead of 500.

description: `escapeLike` doesn't escape `*`, which PostgREST `ilike` treats as a wildcard, so `neighborhood=*` matches every row.
triage_reason: patch — escape `*` in `escapeLike`, so `neighborhood=*` doesn't match every row.

description: `neighborhood` has no length cap, so an oversized value produces an upstream URL error that surfaces as 500.
triage_reason: patch — add a small length cap on neighborhood, for example 100 characters.

description: A null `count` falls back to `count ?? 0`, so non-empty data can come back with `total` 0.
triage_reason: defer — a null count is unlikely with `count: "exact"`. Revisit if it is observed.

description: Rows inserted between the range query and the fallback count can leave an empty page with a nonzero total.
triage_reason: reject — a race between two queries is inherent to offset pagination and is benign.

description: Repeated params such as `page=1&page=2` are accepted and the later value is ignored.
triage_reason: defer — repeated params are an edge case, and the first value winning is acceptable. This duplicates 4.

description: The embed select string, `count: "exact"`, and the fallback's `head`/filter calls are never asserted, so the response contract can break with tests still green.
triage_reason: patch — add assertions on the select string, `count` option, and fallback filters in `listings.test.ts`.

description: The `published_at` `lte` test checks the column name only, not the timestamp value.
triage_reason: defer — RLS backstops the filter. Low value.

description: `createPublicClient` is untested, and the route test mocks it away.
triage_reason: defer — the env-var path is low risk.

description: No positive boundary tests for `limit=50` or `page=100000`.
triage_reason: patch — add boundary tests for `limit=50` and `page=100000`. This is cheap.

description: The published-only rule (`published_at IS NOT NULL AND <= now()`) is an undocumented decision in the spec.
triage_reason: reject — the published rule is consistent with the spec's intent.

description: The cross-field price error is attributed to one field only, which satisfies "per-field errors" only loosely.
triage_reason: patch — same fix as 5.

description: A page past the end returns 200 with empty data. The spec is silent on this.
triage_reason: reject — page-past-end returning 200 with empty data is the standard behavior, and the spec is silent.

description: The spec's file list omits `src/lib/listings.ts`, which the diff adds.
triage_reason: reject — the omission from the spec's file list is harmless.

description: Image ordering by `position` relies on S02's `orderImages`, which isn't in the diff, so the requirement can't be verified from the diff alone.
triage_reason: reject — `orderImages` exists from S02 and is unit-tested there.

description: The triage-log claims (`price_cop` not null, RLS makes all columns public) can't be verified from the diff.
triage_reason: reject — the claims are outside the diff and consistent with the schema.

description: The spec says `status: done` while `sprint-status.yaml` says `review`.
triage_reason: reject — a process artifact, not a code finding. The status flag is updated by the workflow.

description: `agent:agents(*)` exposes every agents column (including any internal or future ones) on a public route.
triage_reason: reject: the spec says "agent info" and the triage log accepts the public agent embed. Agents are public-readable by RLS, and no harm from a specific column is shown.

description: No slug format or length validation. The "slug injection" item in the spec's triage log is asserted without evidence.
triage_reason: reject: `.eq()` parameterizes the value, and the DB check constrains the slug format. A bad slug just returns 404, which is correct.

description: Route tests mock both the helper and the client, so the real wiring is never exercised.
triage_reason: reject: this is the same mock style as S03. The route's job is thin, and the helper has its own tests.

description: Helper tests are brittle because they assert the exact select string and call order against a hand-rolled fake builder.
triage_reason: reject: this matches the S03 fake-builder convention. It is a style preference with no named harm.

description: The `lte` assertion checks only the column name, not that the value is "now", and no fake-timer test covers a future-dated row.
triage_reason: patch: assert the `lte` value with fake timers (same root cause as finding 21).

description: No test for slugs that need URL-encoding or contain special characters.
triage_reason: reject: `.eq()` handles encoding, and Next decodes the param.

description: The return type `Record<string, unknown> | null` loses type safety and forces casts in the tests.
triage_reason: defer: a typed `Listing` return is a design change. S03 uses the same loose shape, so it belongs in a shared typing pass.

description: `orderImages` behaviour for equal or null `position` is untested.
triage_reason: reject: this tests `orderImages`, which is existing S03 code with its own tests. It is not part of this diff.

description: `force-dynamic` with no Cache-Control or revalidation means every detail request hits the DB.
triage_reason: reject: `force-dynamic` and no caching mirror S03 and the spec ("mirror the S03 route"). It is a design choice.

description: Behaviour when `agent` is null (deleted or hidden by RLS) is untested and undocumented.
triage_reason: defer: a null agent is a real contract question for the detail page (S-later). It is not a defect in this diff, since the agent FK is likely NOT NULL.

description: A `maybeSingle()` error from duplicate rows surfaces as a 500.
triage_reason: reject: the slug is unique, so duplicate rows cannot occur. Returning 500 on a DB error is correct.

description: No test that the 500 response omits the DB error message.
triage_reason: reject: the route returns a fixed message, which the 500 test already asserts with `toEqual`.

description: Spec says `status: done` while sprint-status says `review`.
triage_reason: reject: a spec status of "done" is the dev workflow's own convention, and the fix would be to edit the spec under review.

description: The spec's triage log comes from a non-independent inline self-review, and its "false"/"rejected" labels are unverified.
triage_reason: reject: this is process commentary, and the fix would be to edit the spec.

description: `last_updated` was hand-edited rather than generated.
triage_reason: reject: the file is a tracking artifact with no behavioural harm.

description: If the agent embed is null, the route returns 200 with `agent: null`, which the detail page may crash on.
triage_reason: defer: same as finding 10.

description: Null or duplicate `position` values may give unstable image order and are untested.
triage_reason: reject: same as finding 8.

description: A slug differing only by case or whitespace returns 404.
triage_reason: reject: case-folding slugs is speculative, and the DB check constrains the slug format.

description: No Cache-Control header, so a CDN or browser may serve a stale listing after it is unpublished.
triage_reason: reject: same as finding 9. Without a cache header, Next dynamic routes aren't cached anyway.

description: `new Date()` on the app server can differ from DB time, so a listing near its publish time may briefly 404 or still show.
triage_reason: reject: the code deliberately mirrors S03's `lte(now)`, and RLS enforces the same rule. A few seconds of skew is negligible.

description: The `lte` cutoff value is never asserted. Changing it to a far-future date still passes every test, so scheduled listings could leak.
triage_reason: patch: add a fake-timer test that asserts `["lte","published_at", <frozen ISO>]`. This is the one verified gap. Merged with findings 5 and 25, and it routes to a test-only patch.

description: The select string and embed are checked only as literal text against a fake client, with no check that PostgREST resolves them.
triage_reason: reject: the same fake-client approach is used in S03, and a real-DB test is out of scope for this story.

description: The loose return type forces casts in tests and gives the detail page no typed contract.
triage_reason: defer: same as finding 7.

description: The spec's `orderImages` requirement is verified only through the helper test with a fake client.
triage_reason: reject: the helper test does assert the resulting image order, which covers the requirement.

description: "Unpublished returns 404" is tested only with a mocked null, and the "<= now" value is untested.
triage_reason: patch: duplicate of finding 21, so the same patch fixes it.

description: Spec `status: done` is inconsistent with the sprint-status `review` state.
triage_reason: reject: same as finding 13.

description: `name`, `message` and `phone` have no length caps, so the public endpoint accepts arbitrarily large values.
triage_reason: decision-needed: caps are worth adding to a public insert, but the limit values are a product choice and the spec is silent. Merges with 14, 23.

description: The email regex accepts malformed addresses such as `a@b..c`, `a@.com` and `a@b.`.
triage_reason: reject: the DB check is only `@` position and a precise regex adds complexity for low-impact bad emails.

description: An unknown or unpublished `listing_id` (FK/RLS rejection) returns 500 instead of 4xx, and the test pins `23503` to 500.
triage_reason: reject: the spec explicitly maps all DB errors to 500.

description: There is no rate limiting, honeypot, captcha or body-size limit, and no follow-up item records the gap.
triage_reason: reject: the spec's triage already scoped abuse protection out of S05.

description: The "normalized lead" route test only exercises name trimming, not email or message trimming or inner phone spaces.
triage_reason: reject: the route test does cover name trimming through the route, and the helper tests cover trimming of the other fields.

description: Several cases are untested: empty-string `listing_id` or `phone`, email over 254 characters, array or primitive body at the route level, and wrong content-type.
triage_reason: patch: add the missing tests. Overlaps 20 and 21.

description: A JSON-parse failure puts `body` into the `errors` map, which is otherwise keyed by field name.
triage_reason: reject: the spec itself defines `errors` for invalid JSON, and this is a design nit.

description: The hand-written `LeadInput` type is not derived from the Supabase schema and can drift silently.
triage_reason: reject: there are no generated types in the repo, so there is no named harm.

description: All route tests mock the client, so the anon-insert-without-`.select()` and RLS assumption is never verified against a real database.
triage_reason: defer: a real-DB test is a separate integration-test effort, and the unverified RLS assumption is worth a later check.

description: The 201 response `{ data: { received: true } }` returns no lead id or Location, and the envelope is undocumented.
triage_reason: reject: anon cannot select, so returning an id is not possible without extra policy, and the spec leaves the body open.

description: Process inconsistencies: spec `status: done` vs sprint `review`, the decisions-log timestamp (13:05) is earlier than the sprint-status update (15:30), implementation detail sits in the frozen block, and the self-review had no independent reviewer.
triage_reason: reject: the finding's only fix is to edit the spec, and the status mismatch is a workflow artifact.

description: No explicit Content-Type check, CORS or OPTIONS handling, and `force-dynamic` is redundant on a POST handler.
triage_reason: reject: speculative hardening with no demonstrated harm, and the redundant `force-dynamic` is cosmetic.

description: `console.error` logs the full Supabase error object, which can contain row details with the visitor's PII.
triage_reason: patch: log only `code` and `message`, a direct correction. Postgres check-violation details can echo the failing row, which holds PII.

description: `name`, `message` and `phone` have no maximum length, so anonymous callers can insert very large rows.
triage_reason: decision-needed: duplicate of 1 (merge into one entry).

description: `request.json()` buffers the whole body with no size limit.
triage_reason: defer: body size is best limited at the platform or infrastructure level, so it is not actionable in this story.

description: The email regex lets `a@b..c`, `a@.b.c` and `a@b.` through.
triage_reason: reject: duplicate of 2.

description: A blank or whitespace-only `listing_id` is silently stored as null instead of being rejected.
triage_reason: reject: coercing blank optional fields to null is intended and form-friendly, and 21 will pin that behavior.

description: All DB errors map to 500, so a client-caused FK or constraint error looks like an outage.
triage_reason: reject: duplicate of 3, and the spec explicitly maps all DB errors to 500.

description: There is no rate limit or duplicate-submission guard on the unauthenticated insert.
triage_reason: reject: duplicate of 4, and out of scope.

description: The 254-character email cap in `validateLead` is not pinned by any test, so removing it would pass every existing test.
triage_reason: patch: add a test for an email over 254 characters, optionally with an exactly-254 case that is accepted.

description: Normalization of empty or whitespace `phone` and `listing_id` to null is not tested, and dropping `|| null` would pass every existing test.
triage_reason: patch: add a test that `""` and whitespace for `phone` and `listing_id` normalize to null.

description: The `message` requirement differs from the nullable `leads.message` column (the reviewer itself noted this matches the spec).
triage_reason: reject: false. This matches the spec ("message non-blank").

description: `name`, `message` and `phone` are uncapped (the reviewer noted this duplicates the length-cap finding).
triage_reason: decision-needed: duplicate of 1 (merge).

description: The 201 body `{ data: { received: true } }` is not defined in the spec.
triage_reason: reject: the spec leaves the body unspecified and the implementation is compatible with it.

description: There is no route-level test for an invalid `listing_id` or `phone`; only the helper tests cover them.
triage_reason: reject: those cases take the same 400 path, and the helper tests cover them. Item 6 covers any route-level addition.

description: The 254-character email limit goes beyond what the spec says.
triage_reason: reject: the cap is harmless and consistent with "valid format". Item 20 pins it.

description: Whitespace-only `listing_id` and `phone` are treated as null rather than rejected, and the spec is silent on this.
triage_reason: reject: the spec is silent and the behavior is intended.

description: PATCH `published:true` on an already-published listing resets `published_at`, which reorders the public newest feed.
triage_reason: defer | Real, but the spec's triage log and `deferred-work.md` already record it; fixing it needs a read-before-write or DB-side coalesce.

description: Cookie-authenticated mutations have no CSRF defense: `request.json()` does not enforce Content-Type or Origin.
triage_reason: defer | Real but speculative: SameSite=Lax blocks cross-site POSTs, and the spec rejected CSRF protection. A Content-Type check would be a policy decision.

description: `getAgent` accepts any valid Supabase user with no agent-row check, so a non-agent gets inconsistent responses (403 on POST, empty list on GET, 404 on PATCH and DELETE).
triage_reason: defer | Not a real defect here: the FK and RLS block non-agents, and an `agents` row check is new behavior outside the spec.

description: The random 6-character auto-generated slug can collide and return a confusing 409 with no retry.
triage_reason: reject | The collision is negligible (36^6 suffixes), and a 409 is retryable. The fix would add complexity.

description: All tests mock the Supabase client, so RLS ownership enforcement is never verified, and `deferred-work.md` does not record this gap for S06.
triage_reason: defer | Real gap, but the pattern is shared with S05 and needs a local-Supabase integration test. It should be added to `deferred-work.md`.

description: Validation gaps: description is length-checked before trimming, there is no price cap, `open_house_at` accepts non-ISO strings and past dates, `city` cannot be null, and latitude and longitude can be set independently.
triage_reason: reject | Minor choices not required by the spec. `open_house_at` is covered in finding 17 and the others are cosmetic.

description: GET has no status/published filtering and silently ignores unknown query parameters.
triage_reason: reject | Not in spec scope, and ignoring unknown query parameters is normal.

description: There is no write path for `listing_images`, and DELETE cascade behavior is unverified.
triage_reason: reject | Image management is outside S06 scope, and the DB cascades.

description: There is no rate limit or body-size cap, error response shapes are inconsistent, and there is no API documentation.
triage_reason: reject | Rate limits, body caps and documentation are out of scope for this story.

description: The finding questions whether the `@supabase/ssr` dependency was added (the diff shows no `package.json` change).
triage_reason: false | `@supabase/ssr` is in `package.json:15`.

description: Bookkeeping is inconsistent: the spec says `done`, sprint-status says `review`, and the self-review used no subagent. Two "rejected" items belong in deferred work.
triage_reason: reject | Process bookkeeping, and the fix would be to edit the spec or status files.

description: `area_m2` with more than 2 decimals near the cap rounds past `numeric(10,2)`, so the DB error 22003 surfaces as a 500 instead of a 400.
triage_reason: patch | A real 500 where input validation should return 400, and the fix is a one-line rounding guard.

description: PATCH `published:true` on an already-published listing resets `published_at`.
triage_reason: defer | A duplicate of finding 1.

description: PATCH on another agent's listing: the reviewer found no gap, because the `agent_id` filter and RLS return 404.
triage_reason: reject | The reviewer found no defect: the `agent_id` filter and RLS give a 404.

description: `description` length is checked on the untrimmed string.
triage_reason: reject | Trimmed-length versus raw-length is cosmetic and arguably safer.

description: `open_house_at` accepts non-ISO strings via `Date.parse`, and an out-of-range year can make `toISOString` throw a RangeError, giving a 500.
triage_reason: patch | A non-ISO string is accepted despite the error message, and out-of-range years can cause an unhandled 500. An ISO regex plus try/catch is an unambiguous fix.

description: A non-Bearer Authorization scheme returns 401 even when a valid session cookie is present.
triage_reason: reject | A non-Bearer scheme returning 401 is an acceptable design, and a fallback would add branches.

description: An auth-server outage during `getUser(token)` is reported as 401, so clients discard valid tokens.
triage_reason: patch | An auth outage reported as 401 is misleading to clients. The fix is to throw when the error status is 500 or higher, so `authenticate` returns 500.

description: An out-of-range page returns PGRST103 with a null count, so the response reports `total: 0`.
triage_reason: reject | Out-of-range paging is an edge case. A total of 0 is a harmless cosmetic inaccuracy, and the fix would add a count query.

description: The auto-slug collision returns 409 for a slug the client never supplied.
triage_reason: reject | A duplicate of finding 4.

description: DELETE leaves `listing_images` storage objects orphaned and sets the leads foreign key to null.
triage_reason: defer | Real, but storage cleanup is image-management scope, which is not in S06.

description: The request body is parsed with no size cap before validation.
triage_reason: reject | A duplicate of finding 9.

description: The `__proto__` key lookup: the reviewer concluded it is practically unreachable and not a defect.
triage_reason: reject | The reviewer concluded it is not a defect.

description: `slug:null` returns a 400 whose message does not mention null.
triage_reason: reject | Cosmetic error wording.

description: A blank `page` or `limit` query value is silently treated as the default instead of returning 400.
triage_reason: reject | A blank parameter falling back to the default is harmless.

description: The missing-env 500 path is covered only by a mocked rejection, not through the real env path.
triage_reason: reject | Test-detail nit. The mocked rejection already covers the 500 mapping.

description: No test asserts the `order` or `select` arguments (images embed), so removing them leaves the suite green.
triage_reason: patch | Real test gap: stripping `order` or `select` leaves the suite green. The fix is to add `call()` assertions.

description: The publish tests only check that `published_at` parses as a date, not that it equals now.
triage_reason: patch | Real test gap: a stale `published_at` would pass. The fix is fake timers and an exact assertion.

description: No test exercises real RLS or the real 23505/23503 errors; the deferred note covers only the `published_at` reset.
triage_reason: defer | A duplicate of finding 5; the integration test is deferred.

description: Re-publishing resets `published_at` (already recorded as deferred).
triage_reason: defer | A duplicate of finding 1.

description: `open_house_at` accepts non-ISO strings such as "1".
triage_reason: patch | A duplicate of finding 16; it is covered by the same fix.

description: Re-publishing resets `published_at`, which the spec's own triage log accepts as a known low-severity item.
triage_reason: reject | Matches the spec's own triage log, which accepts it as a known low-severity item.

description: A malformed or invalid Bearer header never falls back to the cookie, which the spec does not state. The reviewer called this arguably safer.
triage_reason: reject | The behavior is deliberate and safe, and the fix would be to edit the spec.

description: The spec names the helper `requireAgent`, but the code exports `getAgent` and `authenticate`.
triage_reason: reject | Naming-only deviation with no behavioral impact; renaming would require editing the spec or code churn.

description: The `[id]` routes have no test for the auth layer throwing a 500, so "every route path" has small gaps.
triage_reason: reject | Minor, since the auth-500 path is covered once and the `[id]` routes share the same `authenticate`.

description: An RLS insert violation could surface as 42501 and return 500 rather than 403, and no test covers it.
triage_reason: reject | A speculative RLS error code with no demonstrated path. The FK check already maps to 403.

description: Footer and nav link to /privacy, /terms, /search, /neighborhoods, /about, /contact and /login. None of these pages exist yet, so they 404, and the legal pages aren't in the spec at all.
triage_reason: defer: the target pages belong to later stories and the spec forbids building them.

description: The `/api` exclusion and the `/fr` → 404 row are only checked by a manual smoke test. The `.*\..*` matcher also skips any path containing a dot.
triage_reason: patch: add a vitest test of `config.matcher` for `/api`, `_next`, files and normal paths. The dotted-slug concern is a decision for later.

description: There is no `not-found.tsx` or root layout, so the 404 page renders bare or in the wrong language.
triage_reason: patch: add a `not-found` and root layout so the 404 has `html` and `body`.

description: Contact values are placeholders (`573000000000`, `000 0000`) and nothing guards against shipping them. The address sits in the catalogs, contradicting "contact values live in config".
triage_reason: defer: the placeholders are documented, and replacing them is pre-launch content work. The address in the catalogs is a minor spec mismatch.

description: Neighborhood names are raw strings that bypass the catalogs, and nothing verifies the query values match `listings-query.ts`.
triage_reason: reject: they are proper nouns, and matching the DB values is S09 scope.

description: Active nav state is colour-only (no `aria-current`), uses strict equality so nested routes aren't highlighted, and the mobile drawer has no active styling.
triage_reason: patch: add `aria-current="page"`, and use a prefix match for nested routes.

description: The drawer has no focus management, no outside-click close, stays open when the viewport grows past `md`, and has double-announcing `aria-label` plus `aria-expanded`. `aria-controls` points at a missing element.
triage_reason: patch: return focus to the toggle on Escape and close the drawer on locale change. Outside-click closing and the resize case can wait.

description: Tests are weak. The link-click test doesn't exercise the pathname effect. The `not.toContain('""')` check is crude. The navigation mock replaces the real `Link`. The layout test leaks mock state. `generateMetadata`, the skip link and `lang` have no tests.
triage_reason: defer: this is test polish with no functional bug.

description: `Object.fromEntries(searchParams.entries())` drops repeated query params, which will break S09 multi-value filters.
triage_reason: patch: use `getAll` to keep repeated query keys.

description: The dark-mode block and Geist font were removed. Brand colours are hardcoded hex values in components instead of tokens.
triage_reason: defer: the Geist and dark-mode removal is documented, and token consolidation is cosmetic.

description: The skip link has a minimal focus style. The footer's heading levels are odd. There is no `metadataBase`, hreflang alternates or Open Graph tags.
triage_reason: defer: SEO metadata and heading polish are outside S07's ACs.

description: There is no jest-dom, so tests use `toBeTruthy`. `next-intl` is on 3.x without `hasLocale`. The spec's Verification section is mixed up and records a skipped checkpoint.
triage_reason: reject: process and dependency hygiene, with no code defect.

description: It says stories 1.1–1.6 are done while the sprint status shows two still in `review`. It duplicates catalog text, and a hand-edited file carries a "regenerate" comment.
triage_reason: patch: fix the epic-context statuses. This is a docs-only fix.

description: A repeated query key (e.g. `?type=a&type=b`) keeps only the last value on language switch.
triage_reason: patch: duplicate of finding 9.

description: The active locale link has no `aria-current="page"`, and clicking it reloads the page.
triage_reason: patch: add `aria-current` on the active locale link, folded with finding 6.

description: The copyright year is frozen at the build year when the page is statically prerendered.
triage_reason: defer: the year only goes stale on deploys, and it is trivial.

description: The Privacy and Terms links return 404 in both locales.
triage_reason: defer: duplicate of finding 1.

description: The drawer stays open after a locale switch because the locale-stripped pathname doesn't change.
triage_reason: patch: also reset the drawer when `locale` changes.

description: Keyboard focus is lost when the drawer closes via Escape or link click.
triage_reason: patch: duplicate of finding 7, fixed together.

description: Nested routes aren't highlighted and nav links lack `aria-current`.
triage_reason: patch: duplicate of finding 6.

description: `/fr` and unmatched paths show Next's bare default 404, with no `lang`, header or footer.
triage_reason: patch: duplicate of finding 3.

description: `generateMetadata` runs for an invalid locale before the `isLocale` guard.
triage_reason: reject: Next calls `notFound` in the layout, so metadata for a 404 is harmless.

description: `setRequestLocale` is called with an unvalidated param, and the page runs in parallel with the layout guard.
triage_reason: reject: `generateStaticParams` and the layout guard already cover it, so the risk is low.

description: The parity test misses dropped ICU placeholders and whitespace-only values.
triage_reason: defer: the parity test is adequate for now, and placeholder comparison is a nice-to-have.

description: The global navigation mock ignores array queries and never exercises the real `createNavigation`.
triage_reason: defer: add one real-navigation test together with finding 30.

description: The claim "every visible string comes from the catalogs" is untrue for neighborhood names.
triage_reason: reject: duplicate of finding 5.

description: The claim that the switch keeps path and query is untrue for repeated keys, and the hash is dropped.
triage_reason: defer: the hash is dropped, which is a minor limitation, and the repeated-key part is covered by finding 9.

description: No test covers the matcher keeping `/api`, `/_next` and files out of locale routing, so a regression would break the leads and listings APIs while CI stays green.
triage_reason: patch: duplicate of finding 2.

description: Locale routing and the language switch are tested only against a hand-written mock, never the real next-intl output.
triage_reason: patch: add a `getPathname` test that bypasses the mock, which also covers findings 25 and 34.

description: `LocaleLayout` itself is never rendered, so the `/fr` → 404 and `<html lang>` rows have no tests. The `pathname` close effect is also untested.
triage_reason: patch: add a `LocaleLayout` test for `lang` and the `/fr` 404. The pathname-effect test can wait, since the click handler covers the AC.

description: The sale/rent filter hrefs and the privacy/terms hrefs have no assertions.
triage_reason: defer: low risk, and the assertions can land with S09.

description: `footerNeighborhoods` bypasses the "no hardcoded user-visible strings" rule.
triage_reason: reject: duplicate of finding 5.

description: The address is a contact value kept in the catalogs, but the spec says contact values live in `site.ts`. The spec's Implementation Notes call the address a placeholder in `site.ts`.
triage_reason: defer: duplicate of finding 4.

description: The mocked navigation means the I/O row "`/en/search` → click ES → `/search`" and the keep-path-and-query boundary are not really verified.
triage_reason: patch: duplicate of finding 29.

description: The unknown-locale 404 and the `lang` attribute (es/en) are not verified by any test.
triage_reason: patch: duplicate of finding 30.

description: No test asserts the "middleware excludes /api" constraint.
triage_reason: patch: duplicate of finding 2.

description: The drawer may stay open after a language change, so "closes on navigation" is not fully met.
triage_reason: patch: duplicate of finding 18.

description: The privacy and terms links point at nonexistent routes and aren't recorded as known gaps.
triage_reason: defer: duplicate of finding 1.

description: The palette tokens task is only partly done (emerald and gold aren't tokens), and the dark-mode removal isn't in the spec.
triage_reason: defer: duplicate of finding 10.

description: Implementation notes are mixed into the Verification section, which is minor spec hygiene.
triage_reason: reject: documentation hygiene only.

description: Neighborhood select options come from the footer link list, which may not match neighborhoods that have listings, and nothing tests that `/search` accepts them.
triage_reason: defer — The spec explicitly says to reuse the footer list, so a fixed subset is a product choice for a later story.

description: A swallowed DB error returns `[]`, so with `revalidate = 300` the empty state can be cached for up to 5 minutes, and the catch-and-log path has no test.
triage_reason: patch — A transient error cached as the empty state for 5 minutes is a real defect (this finding, 6, 18, 31 and 32 overlap), and the fallback test is covered in finding 20.

description: Plain `` with an eslint-disable, no `width`/`height`/`sizes`, and lazy loading near the fold.
triage_reason: reject — Plain `` is a deliberate, disabled-lint choice; this is optimization polish.

description: Alt text falls back to the title inside a link that already contains the title, so it is announced twice, and the whole-card link has a very long accessible name.
triage_reason: reject — Double announcement is a minor a11y nit; the card link is the expected pattern.

description: The ordering and published filters are tested only as mock call arguments; the `lte` call isn't asserted and `new Date()` is non-deterministic.
triage_reason: patch — The `lte` published filter should be asserted, because "unpublished excluded" is a spec requirement. Fold into the `featured-listings.test.ts` update.

description: Rows are cast through `unknown`, `price_cop` is typed `number` but wrapped in `Number()`, and null bedrooms or bathrooms are unguarded.
triage_reason: patch — A null or string value rendering "NaN" is a correctness risk (this finding, 17 and 19 overlap); add `Number.isFinite` and null guards.

description: The rent price renders with a stray space and a doubled slash around `/mes`, and no test covers the rent branch.
triage_reason: patch — The rent price spacing/slash defect is small; fix it and add a rent test.

description: The form action hardcodes `es` as the unprefixed default locale instead of deriving it from the routing config.
triage_reason: patch — Hardcoded `es` prefix duplicates the routing config (this finding, 22 and 27 overlap); derive it from the routing config.

description: The Sell card links to the unbuilt `/contact`, and the three "Learn more" links share the same label.
triage_reason: reject — The 404s are expected until S09/S10 land, and `/contact` is out of scope per the spec's "Never" list.

description: Hero a11y details: redundant `role="search"` on a form, no focus-visible styling on cards, unverified contrast on small text, and the empty-state copy has no CTA link.
triage_reason: reject — These are speculative design nits with no spec basis.

description: The old `Metadata` namespace usage was removed and no `generateMetadata` replaces it, so the home page loses its SEO metadata.
triage_reason: defer — The loss of home-page metadata is out of this story's scope; handle it in a later metadata story.

description: There is no page composition test and no es/en catalog parity test, and the spec's checklist items are ticked without evidence.
triage_reason: defer — A page composition test is a nice-to-have, and the parity test is covered by the existing i18n test per the Acceptance Auditor's note.

description: The `→` arrows and `COP` are hardcoded, area has no number formatting, and the price regex in the test is ICU-dependent.
triage_reason: reject — The arrows and ICU-dependence are trivial, and `COP` currency labelling is intended.

description: A plain GET form submits empty selects as `operation=&neighborhood=&property_type=`, but the spec says empty fields are omitted.
triage_reason: patch — Empty params contradict the explicit spec rule "empty fields omitted"; add a client submit handler or strip empties. The parser tolerates empties, so severity is low.

description: The test asserts all submitted values are empty, which hides the empty-field omission requirement.
triage_reason: patch — Rewrite the test to assert the correct behaviour (fixed together with 14).

description: The Sell card's "Learn more" link goes to `/contact`, which isn't built and returns 404.
triage_reason: reject — Duplicate of 9; out-of-scope route.

description: Featured cards link to `/listings/{slug}`, which isn't built and returns 404.
triage_reason: reject — Duplicate of 9; the detail route comes from S10.

description: Null or string `price_cop`, bedrooms, bathrooms or `area_m2` render "COP NaN" or break the plural message.
triage_reason: patch — Duplicate of 6; fix together.

description: A fetch failure during ISR caches the empty-state page for up to 300 seconds.
triage_reason: patch — Duplicate of 2; fix together.

description: A null or non-array `row.images` embed could throw in `orderImages` and blank the whole featured list.
triage_reason: patch — Guard with `Array.isArray(row.images)`; this is a cheap defensive fix.

description: The `loadFeatured` try/catch fallback has no test through the page, so removing it leaves every test passing.
triage_reason: patch — Add a page-level test for the `loadFeatured` catch fallback; this is the only coverage for a spec-mandated rule.

description: Empty-field omission is asserted the wrong way round, and no test selects options or checks the `sale`/`rent` option values or the resulting params.
triage_reason: patch — Duplicate of 14/15; extend the tests to select options and assert the `FormData` entries.

description: The hardcoded `es` locale prefix duplicates the routing config, and the test covers only `es` and `en`.
triage_reason: patch — Duplicate of 8; fix together.

description: Nothing verifies that the `/contact` route exists; the test only pins the href string.
triage_reason: reject — Duplicate of 9; pinning the href is sufficient.

description: The Sell card and featured cards link to routes not yet built (`/contact`, `/listings/[slug]`, `/search`), and the stub state isn't flagged anywhere.
triage_reason: reject — Duplicate of 9; the stubs are expected.

description: The catalog parity row from the spec's I/O matrix has no test in this diff, and the form test doesn't check the resulting query string.
triage_reason: defer — The parity test likely already exists in `i18n.test.ts`; verify it and then close this.

description: The form submits empty params, which conflicts with the "Empty search → /search" row and the "empty fields omitted" constraint.
triage_reason: patch — Duplicate of 14; handled by the same fix.

description: The hardcoded locale prefix is brittle against "current locale's /search".
triage_reason: patch — Duplicate of 8; handled by the same fix.

description: Neighborhood options are a fixed footer subset, so listings in other neighborhoods can't be searched from the hero.
triage_reason: defer — Same product choice as 1.

description: The published filter isn't asserted in the test and wasn't compared against the `listings.ts` pattern.
triage_reason: patch — Duplicate of 5; fix together.

description: The price regex depends on ICU data in the test environment.
triage_reason: reject — Duplicate of 13; low-value polish.

description: The unspecified `revalidate = 300` combined with the error fallback can cache an error-induced empty state.
triage_reason: patch — Duplicate of 2; fix together.

description: AC 4 (`npm run build` and `npm test` pass) is unverified by this audit.
triage_reason: defer — Verifying build and tests is a post-review step, not a code finding.

description: An invalid `page` param is silently dropped, and the notice doesn't say which filter was ignored.
triage_reason: reject. `page` errors are in `errors`, so the notice does fire and `page` falls back to 1. Naming the ignored filter is a nicety that needs added complexity.

description: If the cleaned retry parse still fails, the page shows the generic "could not load" alert and the branch is untested.
triage_reason: reject. `cleaned` is always parseable once the erroring keys are removed, so the branch is effectively unreachable.

description: A valid `page` past the last page returns empty data and shows "no properties match".
triage_reason: patch. A real UX bug: 30 matches look like zero. Fix by passing `total` and `page` to the empty state, or by clamping.

description: The no-JS GET form uses `action="/search"` with no locale prefix and submits empty fields and `sort=newest`.
triage_reason: reject. It duplicates 18 and 24. Empty strings count as "not provided" in `parseListingsQuery`, so there is no invalid notice.

description: The filter key list is duplicated across the page, the `SearchFilterValues` type and the tests.
triage_reason: reject. A duplicated key list is a maintainability nit with no concrete harm.

description: Nested `aria-live` regions announce twice, with no collapsible filters on mobile and unhidden arrow glyphs in the pagination text.
triage_reason: reject. The `aria-live` part is covered by 20. The disclosure and arrow-glyph points are design preferences outside the spec.

description: The blur push races with Apply, Clear and Enter, giving duplicate pushes and history entries.
triage_reason: defer. The blur race is minor history noise. Covered in more detail by 15 and 16.

description: There is no client-side check for `min_price` greater than `max_price`, and no `max` or NaN guard on the price inputs.
triage_reason: reject. The server already handles `min` greater than `max` by dropping `min_price` and showing the notice, so the claim is partly false. The remainder is a nicety.

description: NaN, zero and null handling is missing for price, area and bedrooms, the filters have no "0 beds" option, and `priority` on the first 3 cards is questionable on mobile.
triage_reason: reject. This duplicates 19. The `priority` and "0 beds" points are speculative.

description: An unset `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL` gives empty `remotePatterns` and `next/image` throws, local 127.0.0.1 images are unverified, and there is a stray blank line.
triage_reason: defer. This is a real config fragility, but the environment variable is required elsewhere and no live check was done. It duplicates 13 and 26.

description: The i18n parity test isn't extended, there is no page test for `page` parsing, the card link is tested only in the default locale, the card links to the not-yet-built S10 page, and the verification claims have no recorded output.
triage_reason: reject. A bundle of spec and process remarks. The `page` test gap is tracked in 25, and the other points aren't defects.

description: A valid page beyond the last page gives empty data with `total` above 0, so the empty state hides the pagination.
triage_reason: patch. This duplicates 3. Same fix.

description: If the `image.url` host isn't in `remotePatterns` or the URL is empty, `next/image` throws during render and the page 500s.
triage_reason: defer. A bad host or empty URL is unlikely when the data comes from Supabase storage. Hardening against it needs a guard, so it's low priority, not a patch.

description: A valid `bedrooms` or `bathrooms` URL value of 0 or above 5 isn't among the select options, so the select shows "Any" while the filter is active.
triage_reason: patch. An active filter shows as "Any" and the next change silently drops it. Fix by adding the current value to the options, as is done for neighborhood.

description: Enter followed by blur in a price input pushes twice and adds duplicate history entries.
triage_reason: defer. Duplicate history entries are minor. Dedupe or `replace` needs a design choice.

description: Editing a price and then clicking "Clear filters" lets the blur push race the reset navigation.
triage_reason: defer. A narrow race with no demonstrated data loss, and it duplicates 7.

description: `min_price` greater than `max_price` makes the server drop `min_price` and show the invalid notice, while the panel shows only `max`.
triage_reason: reject. The server handles it (see 8). The panel and notice behave consistently enough.

description: The hardcoded `/search` action can lose the locale prefix with JS off.
triage_reason: patch. `action="/search"` drops the locale. Derive it from the locale-aware pathname. This is a small, direct fix.

description: A null or non-numeric `price_cop`, `area_m2` of 0, or null bedrooms renders "NaN COP", hides the area or shows "0 bedrooms".
triage_reason: reject. The DB columns are likely NOT NULL and the `?` check covers `area_m2`. No demonstrated reachable harm.

description: The count paragraph's `aria-live` sits inside a `<section aria-live>`, so the count is announced twice.
triage_reason: patch. Duplicate announcements from nested `aria-live`. The fix is to remove one of them.

description: For a repeated param with an empty first value (`?operation=&operation=rent`), only the first value is used and the later valid one is ignored.
triage_reason: reject. Edge input from a hand-edited URL, and keeping the first value is documented behavior.

description: The task checklist says "allow local IPs only for a local host", but the code has no local-IP handling.
triage_reason: defer. The notes document that Next 15.5.27 has no such option, so the checklist item is unmet but not fixable. The fix would edit the spec.

description: "Local Supabase images work without it" is not exercised by any test or run.
triage_reason: defer. A spec claim that is unverified without a live Supabase. A manual check is needed.

description: "Empty params are never put in the URL" and "works as a plain GET form without JS" fail on a native GET submit.
triage_reason: patch. Duplicate of 4, 18 and 30. The `action` fix covers the locale, and empties are tolerated by the parser. Treat the two together as one patch with 18.

description: No page test sends `page` (for example `page=2`) or checks it reaches `fetchListings`, and an invalid `page` is also untested.
triage_reason: patch. Add a page test with `page: "2"` and one with an invalid `page`. Both are missing.

description: An unset `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL` gives empty `remotePatterns`, and only the helper is tested, not the config wiring.
triage_reason: defer. This duplicates 10. It would need a config-wiring test and the environment variable.

description: A stray blank line was added.
triage_reason: reject. Cosmetic, and prettier or lint would catch it.

description: Claimed: invalid `sort` and `page` are dropped without showing the notice.
triage_reason: reject. False. Each key in `errors` is deleted from `cleaned` and `invalid` is set, so the notice shows.

description: A failed second parse is reported as a fetch failure (the "could not load" alert) instead of falling back to defaults, and it isn't logged.
triage_reason: reject. This duplicates 2 and is unreachable.

description: The no-JS GET form sends empty params and has an unprefixed action, against the "never empty params" and "works without JS" rules.
triage_reason: patch. This duplicates 18 and 24. Same fix.

description: The AC1 "page is reset" rule is only implicit and has no test, for example starting from `?page=3`.
triage_reason: defer. The behavior is correct and only the test is missing. Low value, though a cheap test could be added alongside 25.

description: The AC1 tests cover only the operation, bedrooms, sort and price controls, not neighborhood, property_type or bathrooms.
triage_reason: defer. Partial test coverage, since all controls share the same handler.

description: The price inputs push on blur or Enter rather than on change, which differs from the literal AC1 wording but is documented in the notes.
triage_reason: reject. Documented, intentional deviation.

description: The i18n parity test isn't extended (AC4), and whether one exists can't be confirmed.
triage_reason: defer. It can't be confirmed that a parity test exists, so the finding is unverified.

description: `FeaturedListings` keeps its own card, which is consistent with the "do not refactor" constraint (the auditor itself says this violates nothing).
triage_reason: reject. The reviewer itself says it violates nothing.

description: A stray blank line was added.
triage_reason: reject. Duplicate of 27 and cosmetic.

description: There is no local-IP handling, contrary to Task 1 (the notes say Next 15.5.27 has no such option).
triage_reason: defer. Duplicate of 22. The notes document it.

description: AC5 verification claims ("230/230 tests, build pass") can't be checked from the diff, and the `remotePatterns` check wasn't run against live Supabase.
triage_reason: reject. A process remark. Fixing it would mean editing the spec.

description: Prices use `format.number` with COP and the monthly suffix only for rent (the auditor notes this meets the requirement).
triage_reason: reject. The reviewer reports it meets the requirement, so there is no defect.

description: Success/error banner stays visible after the user edits a field, and focus is not moved to it.
triage_reason: reject | Low: the banner is a minor UX nit and clearing it needs extra state.

description: Client validation duplicates the server `validateLead` rules, with no parity test.
triage_reason: defer | Real drift risk, but a shared-rules refactor is beyond this story. `leads.ts` is not touched here.

description: Email length over 254 reports "invalid", so the `email.tooLong` message key is never used (dead `invalid` keys for name/message too).
triage_reason: patch | Dead message keys and a mislabeled error code. Direct fix: emit `tooLong` or delete the keys.

description: `go()` navigates from the raw index while the display uses the clamped one, and `aria-current={false}` renders "false".
triage_reason: reject | The clamp already covers the display, and the stale `go()` index only matters if `images` changes, which it doesn't on this page. The `aria-current` "false" is harmless.

description: Gallery has no arrow-key or swipe support and no image-load error handling.
triage_reason: defer | Nice-to-have. The spec does not require keyboard arrows or swipe.

description: `role="region"` on `<aside>` and `<dd>` placed before `<dt>` give wrong semantics.
triage_reason: patch | Small direct semantic fix: drop the redundant `role`, and put `dt` before `dd`.

description: Time is shown in a hard-coded America/Bogota zone with no zone label, and the interval ticks while the tab is hidden.
triage_reason: reject | The fixed Bogota zone fits a Cali-only product. A hidden-tab interval is negligible.

description: `force-dynamic` is set with no stated reason.
triage_reason: reject | Dynamic rendering is needed for a per-request Supabase fetch.

description: `generateMetadata` ignores locale and sets no canonical/hreflang, Open Graph image or JSON-LD.
triage_reason: defer | SEO extras (canonical, Open Graph, JSON-LD) are outside the spec.

description: `listing as unknown as ListingDetail` cast hides any mismatch with the query result.
triage_reason: defer | Cast is a typing smell, but the select is `*`. Would need typed DB generation.

description: The address line is built with separators that can leave stray punctuation when fields are null.
triage_reason: patch | Duplicate of #26. Join the non-empty parts to avoid stray separators.

description: A fetch error that the spec says is "Logged" is not logged, and there is no back link or route-level error/not-found page.
triage_reason: patch | The spec's "Logged" row for fetch errors is unmet. A back link and an error page are out of scope.

description: Migration comes with no seed data, so stratum and admin fee are never visible in local development; there is also no rollback note.
triage_reason: defer | The deferred-work note already records the missing seed data. A rollback note is cosmetic.

description: No i18n parity test was extended for the new `Listing` namespace.
triage_reason: defer | Same as #43. `src/i18n/i18n.test.ts` exists and en/es parity holds by inspection.

description: Feminine "asesora" is used for an agent of unknown gender.
triage_reason: reject | Agent gender is unknown and "asesora" matches the existing copy in `es.json`.

description: "HOA fee" wording and mixed abbreviated/full time units; `openHouse.label` and `openHouse.title` are redundant.
triage_reason: reject | Wording and polish only, with no harm.

description: No consent text, honeypot or captcha on the public lead form.
triage_reason: reject | Anti-spam is outside this story, and rate limiting is the server's job.

description: Tests run in jsdom only and have no "focus not stolen" case.
triage_reason: reject | Duplicate of the "focus not stolen" gap (#41). jsdom-only is the project's norm.

description: The `fetch` to /api/leads has no timeout or abort, so the button can stay disabled on "Sending…" forever.
triage_reason: patch | A hung request locks the form forever. `AbortSignal.timeout` is a one-line, unambiguous fix.

description: Every non-OK response (400 field errors, 429) shows the same generic error.
triage_reason: decision-needed | Mapping 400 field errors and 429 to specific messages needs a UX/copy choice and new message keys.

description: State is set after the component may have unmounted.
triage_reason: reject | React 18+ ignores state updates after unmount, so there is no harm.

description: The double-submit guard relies on render state, so two submits in the same tick can both pass and send duplicate leads.
triage_reason: patch | A real duplicate-lead risk, since the spec guarantees a single request. Add an in-flight ref.

description: The client phone regex rejects numbers the server accepts, such as "ext 123-4567".
triage_reason: decision-needed | Client may block phone numbers the server accepts. Whether to relax the client or tighten the server is a product choice.

description: An unknown `property_type` value makes next-intl fail on a missing message.
triage_reason: reject | `property_type` is a constrained enum and the same lookup is already used by ListingCard.

description: An `area_m2` of "0" or NaN renders "0 m²" or "NaN m²".
triage_reason: reject | Unlikely data; the DB likely constrains `area_m2` to be positive, and fixing it adds guards.

description: The location line has stray separators when neighborhood or address is empty.
triage_reason: patch | Same defect as #11. Join non-empty parts.

description: An agent phone with no digits renders an empty `tel:` link.
triage_reason: reject | Unlikely data with a more-than-trivial fix.

description: The meta description is cut with `slice(0,160)` without collapsing newlines and may split a surrogate pair.
triage_reason: reject | Cosmetic meta-description tidying.

description: `findListing` rethrows fetch errors without logging them.
triage_reason: patch | Same as #12. Log the error before rethrowing.

description: The index state goes stale if the `images` prop changes.
triage_reason: reject | The `images` prop never changes on this server-rendered page.

description: `next/image` has no `onError` handling, and `priority` is set on every main image.
triage_reason: defer | Image-load error fallback is a nice-to-have. Host patterns are already configured in `next.config`.

description: The countdown is stale after a backgrounded tab resumes, and the interval keeps running after expiry.
triage_reason: reject | The next tick corrects the countdown within one second, and the banner is hidden once expired.

description: Duplicated `EMAIL_RE`, `MAX` and phone rules could drift from `leads.ts` with no test failing.
triage_reason: defer | Same as #2. Add a parity test later.

description: No test shows the real query returns the new `stratum` and `admin_fee_cop` columns.
triage_reason: defer | The select is `select("*, ...")`, so the columns flow through once the migration is applied. A real-DB test would need infrastructure.

description: `getCountdown` returns null when under one second remains, although `open_house_at > now` should show the banner.
triage_reason: reject | Sub-second edge case. The spec's Implementation Notes record this deviation.

description: The banner is absent from server-rendered HTML because it renders only after mount.
triage_reason: reject | Intentional, for hydration safety. The countdown is meaningless in static HTML.

description: Client phone check is stricter than the server rule it is meant to mirror.
triage_reason: decision-needed | Duplicate of #23.

description: The "same as server" comment is inaccurate, since the 254 email length check is reported as "invalid" rather than "tooLong".
triage_reason: patch | Duplicate of #3. Fix the comment and the error code together.

description: Unused message keys: `errors.name.invalid`, `errors.message.invalid`, `errors.phone.required`, `errors.email.tooLong`.
triage_reason: patch | Duplicate of #3. Remove or wire the unused keys.

description: The "single request" double-submit guarantee has no same-tick guard, and the test submits only after re-render.
triage_reason: patch | Duplicate of #22. Add a ref guard and a same-tick test.

description: The "focus not stolen" requirement has no test.
triage_reason: defer | The code doesn't move focus, so the requirement is met implicitly. Adding the test is optional.

description: Hard-coded timezone and non-localized gallery glyphs against "every user-facing string comes from messages".
triage_reason: reject | A timezone is a format choice rather than a string, and the glyphs are labelled by `aria-label`.

description: The spec task "extend i18n parity coverage" has no change in the diff.
triage_reason: defer | Duplicate of #14. Parity holds by inspection, and an existing i18n test may already cover it.

description: The `as unknown as` cast means the claim that the new columns are selected cannot be checked from the diff.
triage_reason: reject | Duplicate of #10. `fetchListingBySlug` uses `select("*, images:listing_images(*), agent:agents(*)")`, so the columns are included.

description: Coordinates may never be fetched, because the Supabase select list is not touched and tests only use mocks.
triage_reason: Blind Hunter, coordinates may not be fetched: reject. `fetchListings` and the search code use `select("*")`, so the columns come back. Only the regression test is missing (see the `SearchFilters.test.tsx` and `listings.ts` entries below).

description: No link between list cards and pins: `selectedId` never gets set from a card, and the selected card is not scrolled into view.
triage_reason: Blind Hunter, no card-to-pin link: defer. The spec did not ask for it and it is an enhancement.

description: The map shows only the current page of 12 results, while it is presented as where the filtered listings are, and the counts can disagree.
